description: Russia 'increasingly obstructing' return of Ukrainian children from occupied territories. According to the Head of Policy of Bring Kids Back UA, Oleksandra Dvoretska, the number of children Ukraine is managing to bring back from Russian-occupied territories has recently increased compared with previous periods.
